name: OM2 Network Co.,Ltd.
summary: OM2 Network Co.,Ltd. retails meat and prepared food products in Japan. The company is involved in the meat processing activities; meat product retail; food products retail; as well as offers private label products, such as sauce, hotpot soup, and other products. It operates meat stores; various restaurants; and Japan operations management and operation guidance and store development. OM2 Network Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
